preconditions.description: The input root node is not None.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, object) and hasattr(root, 'data') and hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right')
preconditions.description: The root node has attributes 'data', 'left', and 'right' representing the tree structure.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, object) and hasattr(node, 'data') and hasattr(node, 'left') and hasattr(node, 'right') for node in tree_nodes(root))
preconditions.description: All nodes in the tree have the required attributes 'data', 'left', and 'right'.
The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum_path(root, leaf) for leaf in leaf_nodes(root))
postconditions.description: The return value is the maximum sum of any path from a leaf node to the root.
The maximum path sum is within the range [-10^6, 10^6].
